seo_description: How Fast Focus tripled executive engagement for the MACH Alliance by designing around 23 minutes of learning time a week.
label: Case study: The MACH Alliance, 2023–2024
headline: Fast Focus: learning for leaders with 23 minutes a week.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: CTOs, CMOs, CEOs, Heads of Product

stats.label: of reflections aligned with transformation goals

challenge.label: The challenge
challenge.headline: Leaders wanted clarity without coursework.
paragraphs: The MACH Alliance helps companies move to composable architecture. Its credentialed courses were rigorous, but they demanded time and focus that senior leaders didn't have.
Leaders reported an average of just 23 minutes a week for learning. They wanted insight without instruction, and behavior change without traditional assessments.

change.label: What changed
before: Full credentialed courses as the only entry point
Significant time and cognitive investment up front
Community platform used as a passive forum
after: Units scoped to 15–20 minutes, inside the attention budget
Podcast-style audio lessons for on-the-go learning
Reflection prompts instead of quizzes, with cited sources
Monthly live AMAs and a link back to full courses for depth

items.title: Cognitive load
items.text: Chunked content reduced overload and sped uptake.

items.title: Dual coding
items.text: Paired audio and text strengthened retention.

items.title: Self-explanation
items.text: Reflection prompts connected ideas to leaders' own work.

items.title: Autonomy
items.text: Leaders chose how and when to learn.

measuring.label: Measuring it
measuring.headline: Feedback without friction
paragraphs: Instead of quizzes, leaders got a five-question, mobile-friendly survey at month's end, timed for when they actually skim their inbox. About 65% opened it and about 30% completed it.

Engagement signals from community activity, email clicks, and AMA attendance fed each iteration. Non-technical leaders began using shared language with technical teams, and the community platform became a credible learning destination.
